elevations.notes: Four opening axes on both upper rows, narrow barred lower windows. West wing is physically set back from the projecting central portico. Upper wall is warm desaturated pink/sandstone behind cream columns/pilasters; rusticated ground remains cream above gray-brown granite plinth, matched to opened Street View.

Six fluted Corinthian columns, five upper opening axes, three ornate central ground doors and the raised plinth balustrade. Upper wall is warm desaturated pink/sandstone behind cream columns/pilasters; rusticated ground remains cream above gray-brown granite plinth, matched to opened Street View.

Four upper axes. Source main wall is set back separately from the central portico. Upper wall is warm desaturated pink/sandstone behind cream columns/pilasters; rusticated ground remains cream above gray-brown granite plinth, matched to opened Street View.

limitations: Only the three directly observed south front planes are restored. Unobserved side, rear, roof, and narrow inset returns retain municipal source materials.
Column shafts, capitals and balustrade are original flat artwork on the unchanged source wall plane, without added projecting geometry.
Opening dimensions and vertical positions are approximate; street-level alignment requires final runtime confirmation.
dimensions: Source plane bounds are exact municipal geometry; opening positions, dimensions and colours are authored approximations fitted to observed architectural rhythm. No survey accuracy is claimed.
